BiblicalUsage: God says, I did know thee in the wilderness, in the land of great drought. The word is desiccation, a parched and burning land. It appears once, in the memory of a God who knew His people when there was nothing to drink.
TheologicalSignificance: Tender before it is terrible — that is how this verse strikes me: He knew them in the drought, and the drought is named so the people will remember who kept them alive in it.
